description: The four timed-result families in the shared focused dialog (#672; REQ-019, C45; G07; R43, R82, R100, R115, R116; foundation provider for JOURNEY-019) on Round 7’s owners, carried by A3 TASK-117 (#743): every timed family on /workout is TimedWorkoutFlow (src/ui/timed-workout-flow.tsx), which offers one primary “Log results” action in its full-width action row once its attempt has ended (stating aria-expanded) and opens the same TimedResultLog (src/ui/timed-result-log.tsx) in its one LoggingOverlay (src/ui/logging-overlay.tsx) — a native modal titled “Log results” drawn inside the flow, the framed icon-only Close log X focused, the Balanced backdrop, the workout behind inert — holding the family’s own fields, its form named “Log section results” (round-07 decision R7-3) and its own Save log, which the product binds to the shell’s one completion path. Round 7 opens the log as the attempt ends; the X and Escape keep every entry; the ladder’s quiet Undo finish · resume ladder closes it and resumes the attempt; a refused save keeps every entry and its retry writes the same rows once (block_results, then block_movement_results); a saved log reads back as “Log saved” with Round 7’s Edit log. Owner decision 3 (2026-11-16): the ladder’s log opens only after its attempt ends. The accepted gallery states emom, amrap, for_time and ladder (bec4454) open the route’s own log from the card in all four skins at 390, over memory only. Each case keeps its build name; evidence/refinement/task-117/test-ledger.json records each Round 7 read. Every declared case must execute and pass.
